Inputs placed inside that checkout, as a verification lock names them:
  caller.lock.json  the lock of livingproof-verification's unitree-g1-playground-mujoco-hallway
                    definition (livingproof-verification verifications/, lock format 0.2.0)
                    NOTE: that lock's nominal pins (G1 v2.3.12, sim v3.6.2) did not produce the
                    recording; the checkout above and sim v3.8.1 did.
  specs/scenarios/walk-hallway/parameters.json  robot-capability-specs v2.3.0, sha256

                    (the same bytes as tests/fixtures/sim-1e020b2/world.json)

Commands, run from the checkout (one trial, command_speed 0.5 forward, no seed, no noise):
  python -m livingproof_sim_mujoco.evidence lpl_g1.adapter:ROBOT playground OUT/ev \
      --lock caller.lock.json --trials 1
  echo '{"trials": []}' > verification.json      # no PASS/FAIL pick, so no video
  python -m livingproof_sim_mujoco.media lpl_g1.adapter:ROBOT playground OUT/ev \
      verification.json OUT/media --lock caller.lock.json

Copied unchanged: OUT/media/mcap/trial-01.mcap, OUT/media/mcap/trial-01.binding.json and

unless its re-run observation hashes to the evidence's, so the MCAP is of the graded trial.
